demographic_modifiers.note: Escalate for any significant abdominal pain — multiple obstetric causes possible
Escalate with vomiting or fever — appendicitis and intussusception possible

explanation_template: Your symptoms include abdominal pain, which has many possible causes. Mild pain may resolve with rest, but persistent or severe pain — especially with fever or vomiting — should be assessed by a healthcare provider.
care_level: Pharmacy / Clinic (Emergency if severe or red flags)
